description: Tools are legitimate software that can be used by threat actors to perform attacks. Knowing how and when threat actors use such tools can be important for understanding how campaigns are executed. Unlike malware, these tools or software packages are often found on a system and have legitimate purposes for power users, system administrators, network administrators, or even normal users. Clusters imported from STIX Tool objects. Each cluster keeps the STIX version of the object it comes from (2.0, 2.1, ...) in its `spec_version` meta field.
name: STIX Tool
